Behind AngelWingsUAS

Hi, I’m Jevita.

AngelWingsUAS brings together my love of technology, aerial imagery, and sharing new perspectives. The name is inspired by my granddaughter, Angel.

Have a property, project, or event you’d like to capture? Visit my business website to learn about services and get in touch.
